_why_this_file_exists: A static host has no directory listing, so docs/index.html cannot discover
the prediction files in data/ by asking the server what is there. This
manifest is that listing. It is the one place a filename is written down.
ADD A LINE HERE AFTER EVERY scripts/run_forward.py RUN. A prediction file
that is committed but missing from this manifest simply will not appear on
the page -- the run still counts as evidence, it just is not displayed.
Newest first; the page selects the first entry by default.
